text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. Thanks for the
time off!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It gave me time to pickle some veggies
and
refresh my supply of crunchy
munchies.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I tried out a new rice bran starter I've
had my eye
on too. I'd say it was a
pretty good break!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Say, have you had breakfast? If not, I'm
happy to
give you some of my crunchy
munchies.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looks like Wonder Acute used her break
as an
opportunity to make her favorite
food.
